data.content_ref: inline:The target is one-sided: it makes sky-view geometry the single dominant mechanism for both the existence and cross-city variation of the nocturnal UHI, omitting anthropogenic heat release and surface thermal storage as alternative dominant contributors. But the problem asks what single mechanism BEST explains the gap; by excluding anthropogenic heat from its claim/mechanism while the counterconditions do not guard against that rival, it fails to justify why radiative trapping is superior.
